plugins.name: ihateposting
plugins.description: Draft, check, schedule and publish posts to 14 social networks from Claude: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, Tumblr and Slack. It works through the hosted iHatePosting MCP server; you sign in with your iHatePosting account, and there is no API key to paste.
